7094.title: Native provider questions retain the turn indefinitely
7094.rootCauseOneLine: Provider question registration omits an expiry timer, leaving the active interaction and turn-blocking predicate pending indefinitely.

prReviews.topFinding: Restart re-arming excludes existing questions with null deadlines.

7094.proposedFix: Expire unanswered native questions through the existing interruption path; recover deadlines on restart and preserve approval/answer semantics.
7094.caveats: Real server lifecycle and migrated SQLite reproduced twice; no live Claude model or macOS app was exercised.
